process_documentation: Fetched official BKG VG250 coastline geometry with AGZ=9 and BKG DLM250 river-surface and standing-water geometry in EPSG:25832 through WFS 2.0. Selected standing water of at least 1 km², projected all inputs into the shared 1536×1536 north-up view box, simplified the combined geometry deterministically to the 95 KB SVG budget, and emitted a transparent water overlay without labels or invented features.
notes: Visual inspection confirms the coastline, broad rivers, and large lakes align with the country and state-boundary proofs.
Dense small water geometry is intentionally subordinate; major rivers receive a separate higher-contrast overlay.
No label, route, real-world operational guidance, script, external resource, or raster payload is embedded.
